summary: Master board-level strategy and transformation oversight to govern change, ensure compliance, and drive resilience. Enroll in this 5-day intermediate TrainingCr
lede: Board-level transformation oversight helps directors distinguish strategic direction from operational management and review transformation progress. Designed for directors and other professionals who govern change at board level, the course develops strategic questioning, enterprise risk assessment and review of financial and non-financial performance. Participants practise mapping stakeholder communication and designing transformation roadmaps with targets and KPIs for board oversight.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who govern and oversee transformation initiatives at the strategic board level. It is designed for:
audience: Chairperson - Set board agenda and lead
Governance Committee Member - Evaluate governance gaps
Senior Trustee - Ensure fiduciary duties align
Risk Committee Director - Monitor transformation-related risks
Board Secretary - Facilitate effective board meetings
modules: The Evolving Board Role in Transformation
prerequisites: Participants should have prior board or senior governance experience and basic knowledge of strategic management. No coding required. Participants should prepare a real transformation challenge from their organization to use in workshops. Laptops required for dashboard exercises.
